ActivatedRailInfo.description:
Phase 229 - one configured NeMo Guardrails flow that actually ran
for this check, with NeMo's own real decision log - live-verified to
include every configured rail, not just the one that blocked/modified
something, so a clean pass is still demonstrable, not just asserted.

decisions.description: NeMo's own real sequence of actions this rail took, e.g. ['execute self_check_input'].
decisions.title: Decisions

name.description: Which configured flow ran, e.g. 'self check input', 'mask sensitive data on input'.
name.title: Name

stop.description: True if this rail halted further processing - this is what makes a check 'blocked'.
stop.title: Stop

ActivatedRailInfo.title: ActivatedRailInfo

model_used.description: Which chat model actually generated this answer.
model_used.title: Model Used

DemoLimitInfo.description:
Phase 265 - lets the frontend show "N questions remaining" proactively,
not just react to a block. Null (not present) for an exempt caller
(ADMIN/EMPLOYEE_ADMIN/HR_SUPPORT) - the demo limit doesn't apply to them.
DemoLimitInfo.title: DemoLimitInfo

EvalScores.description:
Phase 109 - live LLM-as-judge scores, same prompts/parsing as the
offline golden-dataset harness (golden_dataset_harness.py), run
synchronously per live response at the user's explicit request
(accepted tradeoff: 2 extra judge LLM calls per live - not cached -
generation). 0.0-1.0, not 0-10 - already normalized by the judge.

answer_relevancy.description: Phase 250 - does the answer address what was actually asked (distinct from completeness's full-coverage check)? 0.0-1.0. Null unless EVAL_ANSWER_RELEVANCY_ENABLED=true (defaults false - a brand-new metric, opt-in not opt-out).
answer_relevancy.title: Answer Relevancy

answer_relevancy_explanation.description: Phase 250 - the judge's reasoning for the answer_relevancy score.
answer_relevancy_explanation.title: Answer Relevancy Explanation

answer_relevancy_prompt.description: Phase 250 - DeepEval's own verbose_logs for this judge call.
answer_relevancy_prompt.title: Answer Relevancy Prompt

answer_relevancy_verdict.description: Phase 250 - RELEVANT (>=0.7), PARTIAL (>=0.4), or IRRELEVANT. Null when not run.
answer_relevancy_verdict.title: Answer Relevancy Verdict

below_threshold.description: Phase 215 - true if any live-computed score (groundedness/completeness/retrieval_precision, whichever are present) fell below the request's eval_options.eval_score_threshold. Always false when no threshold was given.
below_threshold.title: Below Threshold

below_threshold_metrics.description: Phase 215 - which metric name(s) triggered below_threshold, e.g. ['completeness'].
below_threshold_metrics.title: Below Threshold Metrics

completeness.description: Does the answer fully address the question? 0.0-1.0.
completeness.title: Completeness

completeness_explanation.description: Phase 202 - the judge LLM's raw 'Score: X / Reasoning: ...' response, verbatim.
completeness_explanation.title: Completeness Explanation

completeness_prompt.description: Phase 212 - the exact prompt sent to the completeness judge.
completeness_prompt.title: Completeness Prompt

groundedness.description: Is the answer supported by the retrieved context? 0.0-1.0.
groundedness.title: Groundedness

groundedness_explanation.description: Phase 202 - the judge LLM's raw 'Score: X / Reasoning: ...' response, verbatim.
groundedness_explanation.title: Groundedness Explanation

groundedness_prompt.description: Phase 212 - the exact prompt sent to the groundedness judge.
groundedness_prompt.title: Groundedness Prompt

judge_model_used.description: Phase 215 - the real model every judge call this turn actually used (the override if given, else the default) - verifiable, not just trusted.
judge_model_used.title: Judge Model Used

retrieval_f1_estimate.description: Phase 219 - harmonic mean of retrieval_precision and retrieval_recall_estimate. Same estimate caveat as that field.
retrieval_f1_estimate.title: Retrieval F1 Estimate

retrieval_precision.description: Phase 208 - live, computed-this-call: (chunks an LLM judge found relevant) / (chunks retrieved).
retrieval_precision.title: Retrieval Precision

retrieval_precision_explanation.description: Phase 208 - the judge LLM's raw 'Relevant: ... / Reasoning: ...' response, verbatim.
retrieval_precision_explanation.title: Retrieval Precision Explanation

retrieval_precision_prompt.description: Phase 212 - the exact prompt sent to the retrieval-relevance judge.
retrieval_precision_prompt.title: Retrieval Precision Prompt

retrieval_recall_estimate.description: Phase 219 - NOT true recall (that needs the total count of relevant documents that exist, still unknowable for an arbitrary live question). (chunks judged relevant within what was actually retrieved) / (chunks judged relevant across a wider exact-KNN candidate pool - see retrieval_recall_pool_size). Null when nothing in that pool was judged relevant (undefined, not fabricated as 0 or 1).
retrieval_recall_estimate.title: Retrieval Recall Estimate

retrieval_recall_pool_size.description: Phase 219 - how many candidate chunks retrieval_recall_estimate was computed against (capped at 20).
retrieval_recall_pool_size.title: Retrieval Recall Pool Size

retrieval_recall_relevant_count.description: Phase 225 - the real denominator of retrieval_recall_estimate: how many chunks the judge marked relevant across the whole wider candidate pool (retrieval_recall_pool_size chunks), before scoping down to just the originally-retrieved subset (retrieval_relevant_chunk_indices).
retrieval_recall_relevant_count.title: Retrieval Recall Relevant Count

retrieval_relevant_chunk_indices.description: Phase 208 - 1-indexed positions (within this call's retrieved chunks) the judge marked relevant.
retrieval_relevant_chunk_indices.title: Retrieval Relevant Chunk Indices

retrieval_retry_attempted.description: Phase 226 - true when search_options.enable_corrective_retry was on AND the first retrieval's own precision fell below eval_score_threshold, so retrieval ran a second time (doubled top_k) before this answer was generated. Always false when the feature was off, threshold wasn't set, or the first retrieval already passed.
retrieval_retry_attempted.title: Retrieval Retry Attempted

EvalScores.title: EvalScores

ExplainabilityInfo.description:
Phase 107/109 - real latency/token/cache-vs-live/eval numbers,
genai-rag only. Dollar cost is deliberately excluded (see BACKLOG.md).

decompose_model_used.description: Phase 243 - which model ran genai-rag's query decomposition (override if given, else the real default). Null for single-/multi-agentic-rag, or on a cache hit (that step didn't run).
decompose_model_used.title: Decompose Model Used

eval_scores.description: Null for an MCP answer or a no-context answer (nothing to check groundedness against). Reused as-is on a cache hit - same answer, same score, not re-judged.

guardrails.description: Phase 224 - real input/output guardrail status for this answer. Reused as-is on a cache hit, same reasoning as eval_scores.

guardrails_model_used.description: Phase 244 - which model ran the input/output guardrail checks (override if given, else the real default). Always present for a real call, unlike decompose_model_used/planner_model_used - guardrails run on every mode. Reused as-is on a cache hit, same reasoning as eval_scores.
guardrails_model_used.title: Guardrails Model Used

llm_call_count.description: How many LLM calls this request made - 0 on a cache hit or MCP fast-path, 1 otherwise. Excludes eval-judge calls.
llm_call_count.title: Llm Call Count

llm_context.description: Phase 132 (genai-rag), extended Phase 160 to single/multi-agentic-rag; null only on a cache hit (nothing was actually sent this call).

planner_model_used.description: Phase 243 - which model ran multi-agentic-rag's Planner routing step (override if given, else the real default). Null for genai-rag/single-agentic-rag, or on a cache hit.
planner_model_used.title: Planner Model Used

request_id.description: Phase 201 - a UUID4 identifying this HTTP request/response pair, present on every call including cache hits. Correlates this response with backend logs, the request_metrics table, and (when LangSmith tracing is on) that call's trace metadata.
request_id.title: Request Id

routed_to.description: The MCP tool name if this answer was dynamically routed there instead of RAG (Phase 49/108). Null otherwise.
routed_to.title: Routed To

served_from_cache.description: True if this answer came from the answer cache, not a live retrieval+generation call.
served_from_cache.title: Served From Cache

temperature.description: Phase 127 - genai-rag only; null for single/multi-agentic-rag, which hardcode temperature=0, not user-configurable.
temperature.title: Temperature

token_usage.description: Null on a cache hit, MCP fast-path, or a no-context answer that never called the LLM.

ExplainabilityInfo.title: ExplainabilityInfo

GuardrailCheckStatus.description:
Phase 224 - one guardrail check's real outcome. Before this, a
MODIFIED (PII masked) result was indistinguishable from an untouched
PASS to every caller, and a BLOCKED output silently swapped in a safe
fallback answer with zero signal reaching anyone.

activated_rails.description: Phase 229 - every configured rail that actually ran for this check, in order, with NeMo's own real decision log - not just the one rail that happened to matter.
activated_rails.title: Activated Rails

rail.description: Which NeMo Guardrails rail fired. Null on a clean pass, and - confirmed against NeMo's own check_async() logic - also null on a 'modified' result (NeMo itself never attributes a MODIFIED outcome to one specific rail name); see activated_rails for the real per-rail detail.
rail.title: Rail

status.description: 'pass', 'modified' (NeMo masked something, e.g. PII), or 'blocked' (output check only - an input block raises a 422 before any response is built, so it never reaches here).
status.title: Status

GuardrailCheckStatus.title: GuardrailCheckStatus

GuardrailInfo.description: Phase 224 - both of NeMo Guardrails' checks for this answer.
GuardrailInfo.title: GuardrailInfo

decomposition.description: Phase 130 - genai-rag only; time spent splitting the question into sub-questions. Null elsewhere.
decomposition.title: Decomposition

eval.description: Time spent on live eval-judge scoring, in milliseconds. Null when no eval ran this call (cache hit, MCP, or no context).
eval.title: Eval

generation.description: Time spent generating the answer, in milliseconds. Null on a cache hit.
generation.title: Generation

retrieval.description: Time spent retrieving chunks, in milliseconds. Null on a cache hit.
retrieval.title: Retrieval

total.description: Total wall-clock time for this call, in milliseconds.
total.title: Total

LlmContextInfo.description:
Phase 132 (genai-rag), extended Phase 160 to single/multi-agentic-rag -
null only on a cache hit, when nothing was actually sent that call.
LlmContextInfo.title: LlmContextInfo

LlmContextTurn.description:
Phase 132 - one real LLM call's actual rendered prompt, not a re-derived guess -
captured from the exact same inputs the real chain.invoke() call used.

label.description: e.g. 'answer' (single question) or the sub-question text (decomposed).
label.title: Label

latency_ms.description: Phase 205 - wall-clock time of this one real LLM call, not the whole request.
latency_ms.title: Latency Ms

response.description: The raw answer text this turn's LLM call returned.
response.title: Response

LlmContextTurn.title: LlmContextTurn

McpToolCallDetail.description: Phase 132 - the raw MCP call, not just the summary ToolCallInfo already carries.

raw_result.description: The MCP tool's raw text blocks, before being joined into the answer.
raw_result.title: Raw Result

McpToolCallDetail.title: McpToolCallDetail

acl_denied_count.description: Phase 232 - how many documents Document ACL (Phase 231) excluded from this answer's candidate pool. 0 for the common case (no restricted documents, or the caller's role bypasses the gate).
acl_denied_count.title: Acl Denied Count

applied_filter.description: The metadata filter Self-Query actually parsed out of the question, if any.
applied_filter.title: Applied Filter

search_strategy.description: Which retrieval technique actually ran: 'similarity' or 'mmr'.
search_strategy.title: Search Strategy

sources.description: The chunks the answer was actually grounded in.
sources.title: Sources

vector_db.description: Which vector store this query actually ran against.
vector_db.title: Vector Db

RetrievedChunk.description: One chunk the retrieval step considered relevant to the query.

chunk_index.description: This chunk's position within that document.
chunk_index.title: Chunk Index

document_id.description: Which uploaded document this chunk came from.
document_id.title: Document Id

matched_by.description: Phase 221 - hybrid search only: which underlying list(s) found this chunk - 'sparse' (BM25 keyword), 'dense' (vector similarity), or both. Null for every other search_strategy.
matched_by.title: Matched By

score.description: The vector store's own similarity score, null for MMR results.
score.title: Score

text.description: The chunk's text, as stored at index time.
text.title: Text

RetrievedChunk.title: RetrievedChunk

ToolCallInfo.description:
Phase 126: moved here from models/agentic_rag.py - genai-rag's
RagQueryResponse needs it too, and agentic_rag.py already imports
FROM models/rag.py, so defining it there instead would circular-import.

iteration.description: Phase 206 - which ReAct iteration (1-indexed) made this call. Single-agentic-rag only.
iteration.title: Iteration

latency_ms.description: Phase 126 - how long this one call took, if measured.
latency_ms.title: Latency Ms

search_strategy.description: Phase 216 - the agent's own strategy choice for a search_knowledge_base call ('similarity'/'mmr'). Null for every other tool.
search_strategy.title: Search Strategy

success.description: Phase 126 - false if this call returned an 'Error: ...' result.
success.title: Success

tool_input.description: What the agent passed to it.
tool_input.title: Tool Input

tool_type.description: Phase 126 - which kind of backend this hit: vector_db/mcp/web_search/sql_db/other.
tool_type.title: Tool Type

validation_failed.description: Phase 277 - true if the Dynamic Tool Router rejected this call's own arguments before the tool ever ran (a self-correctable mistake, distinct from a real backend failure).
validation_failed.title: Validation Failed

ToolCallInfo.title: ToolCallInfo

conversation_id.description: Echoed/generated when enable_conversation_memory was true - pass it back on the next call to continue this conversation. Null when memory wasn't enabled.
conversation_id.title: Conversation Id

demo_limit.description: Phase 265 - null for an exempt caller (ADMIN/EMPLOYEE_ADMIN/HR_SUPPORT).

tools_used.description: Phase 126 - empty on a normal RAG answer, one entry when MCP-routed (explainability_info.routed_to).
tools_used.title: Tools Used
